name: Desierto de Almería

known.via: English Wikipedia "Desierto de Almería" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra (IGP) covering fourteen municipalities in Almería province, including Tabernas and Sorbas.
